reason: The first thing I check with any reward app is what the points are worth, and here it says right away they can't be turned into cash, so SUP is just a game currency for virtual shoes I don't care about. For my 10 km training I already log runs fine, and my crew organises on KakaoTalk and Instagram, so I'm not going to drag everyone onto a new Android-only app.
objection: The points are worth nothing outside the app, and crew running only works if my whole crew moves over, including the iPhone people, who can't.
would_change_my_mind: If SUP could be exchanged for something real, like gift cards or race entry discounts, and my crew leader moved the crew onto it first.
